newsitem.title: USA: Possis seeks FDA approval for device.
newsitem.headline: Possis seeks FDA approval for device.

text.p: Possis Medical Inc said Tuesday it is seeking approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to market a device which provides synthetic vascular access for kidney dialysis patients.
Possis said its Perma-Seal Dialysis Access Graft with needle sealing capability minimizes bleeding and shortens dialysis sessions.

Possis said a U.S. clinical study comparing the Perma-Seal Graft with conventional grafts was completed with 250 implants at six hospitals. The company has submitted the results, including a requested 12-month follow-up, to the FDA. Based
on recent discussions, Possis said it believes the FDA review process will likely include FDA panel review and yield a final decision before calendar year end.

As previously announced, the device was approved for sale in Europe and in July and the company said it expects to have a worldwide distribution agreement in place by the time FDA marketing clearance is granted.
Possis develops, makes and markets medical devices for the cardiovascular and vascular treatment markets.
Shares of Possis were trading unchanged from yesterday's close at 13-5/8.
